name: astrology
description: Headless astrology API, CLI, file composition and generation runtime

scripts.vendor:core: npm --prefix vendor/astral-core run vendor:build && npm --prefix vendor/astral-core install --ignore-scripts && npm --prefix vendor/astral-core run build
scripts.vendor:interpreter: npm --prefix vendor/astral-interpreter run vendor:build && npm --prefix vendor/astral-interpreter ci && npm --prefix vendor/astral-interpreter run build
scripts.vendor:build: npm run vendor:core && npm run vendor:interpreter && npm run vendor:packager
scripts.build: rm -rf dist data && node scripts/sync-data.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/sync-packager.mjs
scripts.test: rm -rf .test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node .test/test/publicCompatibility.js && node .test/test/interfaces.js && node .test/test/service.js && node .test/test/chartFile.js && node .test/test/generationSemanticProvider.js && node .test/test/recoveryMigration.js
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
